text:
DeployBot: starting staged rollout: service=inference-api model=v2.7.2 cohort=LATAM initial=1% planned-bump=10% after 12m soak. change-window=04:30-05:30 UTC `/deploy start --service=inference-api --model=v2.7.2 --staged=1% --bump=10% --window=04:30-05:30`
Hana: note: this build includes a compatibility shim for legacy tokenizers; there
re two artifact variants (compat vs native). We'll pin canary to compat to avoid S3 artifact mismatch.
Vikram (oncall): holding until auth & latency p99 healthy for 5m. Also watch tokenized.length.delta for spillover.
QA-Bot: running quick regression harness on 200 customer flows (long-context focus).
Infra: pinning canary pool to compat-artifact nodes and setting hotstart-delay=8s.
DeployBot: canary started at 1%. monitoring hooks: auth.fail, latency.p99, tokenized.length.delta, embed.cosine_drift.
TelemetryBot: auth.fail delta=0.0% at 04:32:10 UTC, latency.p99 +12ms, tokenized.length.delta=+0.1%.
Hana: keeping at 1% for the full 12m soak to validate artifact pinning. If anything looks off, we can bump to native-compat later.
QA-Bot: regression harness results: 0 fails on short prompts, 3/200 regressions on very long multi-turn chains (likely boundary tokenization). Pin remains correct approach.
Vikram (oncall): +1 hold until 12m soak complete. If tokenized.length.delta > +2% or embed.cosine_drift > 0.015, call stop.
DeployBot: bump scheduled after soak. `/deploy edit --soak=12m --bump=10%`
TelemetryBot: at 04:42:12 UTC tokenized.length.delta=+1.9% (approaching threshold), embed.cosine_drift=0.007.
Hana: that token length nudge is expected for compat shim on edge chains. Still within tolerance but watch rerank precision.
Infra: one compat pool host reported transient docker image pull latency during warmstart at 04:45:01, recovered. No OOMs.
DeployBot: proceeding to bump to 10% now `/deploy bump --staged=10%`
TelemetryBot: post-bump 04:48:03 UTC tokenized.length.delta=+2.6% (threshold 2.0%) embed.cosine_drift=0.018 (threshold 0.015) rerank.precision.delta=+1.4% (threshold 1.0%).
Vikram (oncall): calling stop. embed drift and rerank precision exceed thresholds. Stop and roll back to v2.7.1-compat.
Hana: concur. The compat shim fixes artifact mismatch but the downstream precision hit suggests we need extra eval. Rolling back.
DeployBot: stop acknowledged. initiating rollback -> model=v2.7.1-compat `/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.7.1-compat`
Infra: scaling down v2.7.2 canary pods, reinstating v2.7.1-compat. Expect warmstart bleed ~70s. Pin removed from canary pool.
TelemetryBot: post-rollback update 04:51:05 UTC embed.cosine_drift back to 0.003, rerank.precision.delta -0.1%, tokenized.length.delta +0.1%.
QA-Bot: full failure set logged to QA ticket #INFER-482; attaching failing traces and tokenized outputs for three regressions.
Hana: next steps: revert compat shim from canary candidate, run extended compatibility job in staging for 3h with full multi-turn suite, and prepare a gradated reattempt that starts on native nodes with explicit artifact migration.
ReleaseNotesBot: adding note: "v2.7.2 LATAM staged canary halted after bump to 10% due to embed drift and rerank precision regression; rolled back to v2.7.1-compat. Action: extended staging soak + artifact migration plan required before reattempt."
Vikram (oncall): I'll update oncall runbook to include emergency pin -> fallback to v2.7.1-compat command snippet.
Infra: runbook snippet for quick rollback pinned in thread:
```
# emergency rollback/pin
/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.7.1-compat
# pin canary to compat-artifact pool
/deploy pin --pool=compat-artifact
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-api -w
```
Hana: I'll open PR with additional eval coverage for long multi-turn token boundaries and coordinate with runtime to instrument token boundaries in traces.
DeployBot: automation closing thread after rollback complete. If follow-ups, open new thread or reply here.
